cards.title: Recovery, but not an AI all-clear
cards.question: Is the weekly rebound broad enough to survive higher rates?
cards.prompt: Weekend Nov 14 drill. Verified Nov 13: S&P -0.4%, Nasdaq -0.91%, Dow +0.1%; S&P gained 2.5% and Nasdaq 2.3% for week. October PPI +6.5% y/y; rate pressure persists. 7d: relief rally amid AI governance concerns; 30d: correction from October high; 90d: high-capex AI cycle. Hypothesis: risk premium reset, not proven demand collapse. Check RSP/IWM vs SPY, 2Y/10Y and forward estimates. Disconfirm if earnings cuts spread despite stable rates. Sources: https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-dip-nvidia-tumult-keeps-investors-edge-2026-11-13/ https://apnews.com/article/f8edd0eeb1494d4d2584715686c5e619

cards.title: Index recovery hides chip stress
cards.question: Are investors rotating or exiting risk?
cards.prompt: Nov 13 Reuters: Nasdaq -0.91% while Dow +0.1%, Nvidia fell for sixth consecutive week. AP: most S&P stocks gained Friday despite index decline; weekly S&P +2.5%, Russell +1.3%. Interpret as dispersion, not necessarily risk-off. Compare 7/30-day equal-weight, credit spreads, semiconductor leadership and IWM. Disconfirm broadening if breadth reverses and spreads widen. https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-dip-nvidia-tumult-keeps-investors-edge-2026-11-13/ https://apnews.com/article/f8edd0eeb1494d4d2584715686c5e619

cards.title: AI demand, rival architectures
cards.question: Can alternative inference systems win durable share?
cards.prompt: Verified TSMC Nov 10: October sales NT$586.89B, +59.7% y/y; Reuters Nov 12-13: Cerebras raised annual sales outlook, while Nvidia governance uncertainty weighs on sector. Hypothesis: customers diversify inference hardware; not proof of sustained market-share migration. Compare Cerebras, AMD, Nvidia, Broadcom on repeat customers, software compatibility, throughput per dollar and gross margin. Disconfirm if adoption is concentrated in one contract or Nvidia execution remains dominant. https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3349 https://www.reuters.com/business/cerebras-raises-annual-sales-forecast-strong-ai-linked-demand-2026-11-12/

cards.topic: Contracted AI capacity versus live capacity
cards.title: Old commitments face delivery day
cards.question: When do contracted megawatts earn revenue?
cards.prompt: Dormant thesis: AI infrastructure commitments made during 2026 now approach 2027 commissioning. CoreWeave Nov 10 reported $132.5B revenue backlog and over 4.6 GW contracted power versus over 1.7 GW active; Nebius Nov 12 reported delays in third-party capacity. Hypothesis: commissioning lag hurts builders' cash flows before suppliers' orders; priced-in: strong demand, less certain: time-to-cash. Disconfirm if live capacity and cash conversion accelerate or supplier orders fall. https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2026/CoreWeave-Reports-Strong-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx https://www.reuters.com/technology/nebius-beats-quarterly-revenue-estimates-strong-ai-demand-2026-11-12/

cards.title: Tuesday tests AI economics
cards.question: Will guidance support 2027 spending assumptions?
cards.prompt: Forward catalyst Nov 17 Nvidia Q3 FY27 earnings, officially scheduled. Bull: resilient order visibility, margins, Rubin roadmap and continuity; bear: weaker guidance, financing pullback, delayed platforms or lost customers. 1-12 months: 2027 capex budgets and actual commissioning. Price already reflects strong AI demand; measure surprise relative to expectations. Do not presume earnings outcome. https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Sets-Conference-Call-for-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-dip-nvidia-tumult-keeps-investors-edge-2026-11-13/

cards.topic: 30-90 day falsifiable supplier versus builder test
cards.title: Test orders against cash conversion
cards.question: Can suppliers hold estimates while builders lag?
cards.selfCheck: Track orders, MW, free cash flow.
cards.prompt: Hypothesis initiated Nov 14, evaluate Dec 14 and Feb 14: profitable memory, foundry, optical and semicap suppliers should retain stronger earnings revisions than debt-intensive neocloud builders if AI demand holds but deployment is delayed. Compare TSMC/MU/COHR/LITE versus CRWV/NBIS, adjusting for valuation and balance sheet. Disconfirm if suppliers' orders or estimates weaken first, or builders commission capacity and generate positive free cash flow faster. Separate operating evidence from stock momentum. https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3349 https://www.reuters.com/technology/nebius-beats-quarterly-revenue-estimates-strong-ai-demand-2026-11-12/
